name: DGX Spark LingSante-3.1-air-VL Atlas (SparkLing 0.1.0)

weights.description: Which checkpoint the engine serves: spark is Enntity's NVFP4 quantization of the original BF16; strict is inclusionAI's original BF16 as published. Both use checkpoint precision and no drafting.

spark.description: Enntity/LingSante-3.1-air-VL-NVFP4 (MIT, about 76 GB): quantized directly from inclusionAI's original BF16, the 61,440 routed expert matrices packed as NVFP4 in groups of 16, the non-expert weights kept as published.

strict.description: inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL (MIT, about 250 GB): the original BF16 checkpoint as published. Atlas pages its expert matrices from disk to fit one Spark.

summary: inclusionAI's LingSante-3.1-air-VL (the medical vision-language Ling) on one DGX Spark with SparkLing 0.1.0's Atlas build: text, image and video input, tools, reasoning, prefix caching and its native 131,072-token window. --weights spark (default) serves Enntity's NVFP4 quantization; --weights strict serves the original BF16. Three modes: default (8 requests), saver (1 request of 8,192 tokens) and max (16 requests). Additive only: no default model, no aliases. Draft: installs once the SparkLing 0.1.0 pins are final.
description: This recipe installs SparkLing 0.1.0 at the immutable product revision recorded in backends/atlas-sparkling/pins-0.1.0.json (a draft until the release is built). The Atlas engine image is built from Enntity/SparkLing by install/build.sh and published to GHCR; LLooM commits no engine source. Setup acquires the selected checkpoint at its pinned revision (Enntity/LingSante-3.1-air-VL-NVFP4 for spark, inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL for strict), pulls the image by its manifest digest and verifies it, then runs SparkLing's own install/check_files.py with install/checkpoint-sante-nvfp4.json or install/checkpoint-sante-air-vl.json, fetched at the pinned revision, digest-checked and run inside the image with no network, to check every inference file against its pinned size and hash. Nothing is assembled: the engine serves the checkpoint directory as downloaded. Setup remembers the weights it installed with.

provenance.source: SparkLing 0.1.0 (draft): Enntity/SparkLing at the revision pins-0.1.0.json will record, engine Enntity/atlas at the commit it will record (AGPL-3.0-only, recorded in the image's /opt/atlas/source-manifest.json). Image ghcr.io/enntity/atlas-sparkling:<first 12 characters of the install/ tree>, addressed by its GHCR manifest digest. Profiles default.json (0.80 GPU memory utilization, 8 sequences), saver.json (0.70, 1, 8192) and max.json (0.88, 16), all with BF16 KV and prefix caching; the engine caps LingSante at its native 131072 tokens. Checkpoints Enntity/LingSante-3.1-air-VL-NVFP4 revision 2702935791ac4f04b2b103c748a19de89f6df940 (MIT; quantized from source revision 1f398c937d6069994a156689636832c47d8c09be) and inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL revision 1f398c937d6069994a156689636832c47d8c09be (MIT), checked against SparkLing's install/checkpoint-sante-nvfp4.json and install/checkpoint-sante-air-vl.json.

hardware.testedMachine: One DGX Spark with 128 GB unified memory
notes: LingSante-3.1-air-VL on one GB10, 2026-11-24 (SparkLing README, development build): on a short single-stream counting probe at 4K context the NVFP4 checkpoint decoded 43.9-44.0 tok/s with SparkLing's optional NVFP4 prefill and attention settings and 54.1-55.0 tok/s with NVFP4 MLPs and vocabulary head as well. This recipe serves SparkLing's default for LingSante instead (checkpoint precision, no drafter; the borrowed Ling predictor, DRAFTER=ling-mtp, is experimental), for which no figure is published yet.
LingSante declares 131,072 tokens natively; the engine caps every profile there (its publisher's 256K configuration uses YaRN and is not served). The KV pool is shared across requests.
A medical model: its answers are not medical advice and it is not a medical device.

Draft: SparkLing 0.1.0 is not released. backends/atlas-sparkling/pins-0.1.0.json is a draft whose SparkLing revision, engine commit, image digest and tool digests are placeholders, so setup stops at verify-atlas-pins until the release fills them in. The container image below is the same placeholder. Video input assumes the release ships SparkLing's video profiles (ffmpeg decoding enabled); confirm on the release image before this recipe is final.

Profiles (SparkLing install/profiles, all BF16 KV, 2,048-token prefill chunks or 8,192 with NVFP4 prefill, prefix caching): default 8 requests at 0.80 GPU memory utilization, saver 1 request of 8,192 tokens at 0.70, max 16 requests at 0.88. Requests the KV pool cannot hold yet wait rather than fail. Strict shares one KV pool between requests (ATLAS_KV_MAX_BLOCKS in each profile) and pages cold experts from the checkpoint on disk, so expect it to be much slower than Spark.

Peak host memory was not measured per mode. LLooM reserves an estimate: saver 92 GB, default 104 GB, max 114 GB. The container is capped at 114 GiB because a GB10 that runs out of shared memory hangs instead of killing a process. In the default and max modes little else should use this Spark's GPU memory.

The engine serves 127.0.0.1:8897 (fixed by the image) with host networking, so only one SparkLing model runs at a time; its memory reservation keeps LLooM from starting the other beside it. Text, image and video input: OpenAI image_url parts and video_url parts (animated GIF decoded in-process, MP4 and WebM through the image's ffmpeg).

Licenses: the Atlas engine and SparkLing's install tools run from the image and are AGPL-3.0-only (not included in LLooM). inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL and Enntity/LingSante-3.1-air-VL-NVFP4 are MIT.

modes.summary: Profile saver: 1 request at 8192 tokens, 0.70 GPU memory utilization, 92 GB reserved (an estimate); leaves room for sidecars.
Profile default: 8 requests at 131072 tokens, 0.80 GPU memory utilization, 104 GB reserved (an estimate).
Profile max: 16 requests at 131072 tokens, 0.88 GPU memory utilization, 114 GB reserved (an estimate).
